name: Apache EventMesh Open-Source Event Middleware
free_limit: Apache-2.0 licensed self-managed event middleware for CloudEvents-based publish/subscribe, event routing and connectors; no vendor software subscription or per-event license quota.
watch_out: Self-hosting requires your own compute, storage and operations; production backends such as Kafka or RocketMQ have separate infrastructure costs. The in-memory storage backend is intended for development and CI, not durable production use. Beta/experimental components have evolving APIs; this is not a free managed event-mesh cloud tier.
